entry.title: Diablo II Archipelago v3.9.20
entry.content:
**Skill points no longer move between skills on relog.** At exit the mod reads each button's level out of the save file to reinvest it after the reset. The game writes those bytes in class-skill-list order, and the mod fills that list compactly, empty buttons skipped, so a button's level sits at "number of filled buttons before it", not at the button's own index. The mod read the wrong byte for every button after the first gap: one skill picked up another's level, the real owner read 0 and fell back to the click cache, and the pool clamp then zeroed the last row. Nothing was lost — the total was constant across cycles — but points wandered on every relog. The read now follows the same compact order the list is written in. Verified against a live log where save bytes 9 to 12 held exactly the levels of buttons 13, 20, 21 and 22.
Points that ended up unspent are in your pool; spend them again once and they stay put.
Plugin stays at 1.2.19.

entry.title: Minishoot Adventures v0.6.0
entry.content:
## [0.6.0] - 2026-09-05
### Added
- A new setting called "Split Surf" has been added. - When enabled, each water type requires its own Surf item to be navigable. - When disabled, the normal Surf item unlocks navigation on all water types. - Will replace Surf and 4 filler items. - Water types are: Normal, Blue, Soiled, Dungeon and Gold. - Logic has been adjusted to accomodate this new setting. - Each surf items will be visible in the inventory. - A new setting called "Split Supershot" has been added. - When enabled, the Supershot is broken down into 2 distinct items. - Blastshot allows you to break rocks and walls. - Flameshot allows you to light torches. - Having one these two items will unlock Supershot for combat usage. - When enabled, Supershot and one filler item will be replaced. - Logic has been adjusted to accomodate this new setting. - Both of these items will be visible in the inventory. - A new setting called "Primordial Crystal Activation Threshold" has been added. - Set the Primordial Crystal activation threshold. - If your current HP percentage is greater than or equal to this value and you have the Primordial Crystal, it will activate. - This allows for more flexibility in the use of the Primordial Crystal, especially in combination with the "Enable Primordial Crystal Logic" option. - This option does not affect logic. The value must be between 10 and 100. - A new setting called "Progressive Boost" has been added. - When enabled, the game will fuse the Boost and the Advanced Energy module into two cumulative progressive upgrades. - The first upgrade will always allow you to boost, and the second will reduce the energy cost of boosting. - Note that both instances of Progressive Boost are marked as "Progression", although the second upgrade does not unlock any location. - A new setting called "Progressive Powers" has been added. - When enabled, the game will fuse all powers and the corresponding idols into two cumulative progressive upgrades. - The first upgrade will always allow you to use the corresponding power, and the second will grant you the idol's effect. - Note that both instances of Progressive Power of protection are marked as "Progression", although the second upgrade does not unlock any location. - The APWorld now has a manifest.
### Changed
- **IMPORTANT** Some settings and location names have been renamed. See [docs/dev/history/0-6-0-renames.md](docs/dev/history/0-6-0-renames.md) for the full list. - This means that you must change your YAML settings file for Archipelago. Refer to the file above for the replacements. - Fixed "Dungeon 3 - Behind North West doors" logic : now properly check for a way to use springboards - Necessary to unlock the door to said location. - All shop locations requiring Super Crystals are now locked behind the same conditions as clearing Dungeon 5. - As of now, there is no guarantee to have a sufficient amount of Super Crystals to buy the items you need. - This is temporary, as work on this very subject will begin soon-ish. - When the goal is set to "Spirit Tower", the Golden Crystal Heart will now replace a filler item, instead of an Ancient Tablet.
### Known issues
- Rarely, when hovering between a piece of land and a piece of water, Minishoot can fall.

entry.title: Diablo II Archipelago v3.9.21
entry.content:
**Zone locks no longer follow you from one difficulty into another.** The mod keeps one lock table and built it once, at character load, from the difficulty stored in the state file. That is the difficulty of the previous session, not of the game being joined. A player who last saved in Hell and then made a Normal game got Hell's locks, nothing received there yet so everything shut, laid over Normal, and a final region they had already cleared was locked again. Keys received in the new game then poked holes in a table that belonged to a different difficulty.
Character load now reads the difficulty from the live game before building the table and before the load-time reconcile, and every difficulty change during play rebuilds the table from that difficulty's own keys. Quest completions, area kills, gate-boss kills, waypoints, level milestones and gate-key receipts were already tracked per difficulty; the lock table was the only piece that was not, so nothing else moves.
Verified against a live log: character loaded with the stored difficulty 2 (Hell), locks applied for Hell, first tick reported "Difficulty change: 2 -> 0" with no rebuild. That is the sequence this fixes.
Plugin stays at 1.2.19.

entry.title: Diablo II Archipelago v3.9.22
entry.content:
**Skill trees with more than 255 points now come back whole on relog.** The save file's skill-point pool is an 8-bit field, so at exit anything above 255 goes to a ledger in the state file and the save keeps 255. At character load the mod rebuilds the reinvest list and budgeted it against the save alone: a player who owned 697 points had six buttons queued and twelve dropped. The dropped points resurfaced later as free pool from the ledger, so nothing was destroyed, but most of the tree emptied on every relog. The ledger is now part of the budget.
**Reinvested points are always paid for.** Each point applied during the reinvest is taken from the live pool, and from the ledger once the pool is at zero. Before, a point the pool could not cover was applied without being paid for, and the ledger later handed the same point back as free pool.
**Three verification passes after every reinvest.** A few seconds after the points are applied, again when the character first moves, and again on the first mouse click, the mod reads each reinvested skill's level back from the live character. A skill found below the level that was applied is topped up through the same path and paid for the same way. The passes log `REINVEST AUDIT` lines with ok/low/missing counts, pool and ledger, so a future report can be checked against the log. A skill the player has raised above the applied level is left alone.
Verified against a live log: cache held 18 buttons totalling 697 points, save pool 255, ledger 442; six buttons were reinvested and the ledger then refilled the pool to 255.
Plugin stays at 1.2.19.

entry.title: Diablo II Archipelago v3.9.23
entry.content:
**Monster shuffle leaves every revivable family alone.** A tester crashed in the Great Marsh with an access violation inside the game's own unit lookup. The minidump shows the unit was a flayer whose monstats row had been given another monster's record by the shuffle, while the flayer shamans, which the shuffle already skips, still revive that row. The fallen family had been protected against exactly this since the sliding-corpse report; the other families a reviver raises had not. Flayers and blowgun flayers (fetish shamans), zealots (cantors), mummies (greater mummies) and reanimated hordes, which rise on their own, now keep their own rows. The greater mummies themselves are skipped as well.
The change only removes swaps, so a running seed keeps every check; a few monsters in Act 2, 3 and 5 look like themselves again.
Plugin stays at 1.2.19.

entry.title: Civilization IV v0.0.1r3
entry.content:
Thanks to Konzera taking the plunge to run this in an actual multiworld, I've fixed a couple of important bugs. You need both the new APWorld and mod for these changes. Check the previous release for more details on Wondersanity and other big changes from 0.2.
### Changelog: - Changed some backend behavior so large lists of items are actually sent to the game. - Fixed a typo preventing the Mausoleum of Maussollos check from being sent
### Installation Instructions: 1. Unzip Civ4-Archipelago-Mod into your Beyond the Sword mod folder (I've been testing it in the My Games one, but theoretically it should also work in the installation folder one; let me know if one or both work or don't work!), make sure the structure is Beyond the Sword/Mods/Civ4-Archipelago-Mod and that there isn't an extra folder in that structure. 2. Install the APWorld as normal.
### Play Instructions: 1. Run the Civilization IV client from Archipelago, but **do not connect from the client**; you'll do so in-game (and eventually I want to remove the ability to connect from the client) 2. Start a new Civ4 Beyond the Sword game as normal--**I highly recommend playing in windowed mode**, since this is an alpha and if the game freezes it can be difficult/impossible to close out of it if it's in full screen mode. 3. When you load in you'll get a popup saying to connect to the Archipelago Server: you do this by opening up the BUG options (the little dragon in the upper-right corner), entering in your information, then clicking "Save and Connect." If the connection is successful you'll get a popup that says "Successfully Connected," and you can play as normal. If you get an error, try connecting again, it most often means you don't have the client open or you're already connected in the client. Occasionally however the connection will be slow and you connect in the client but get an error in-game; in that case disconnect in the client and try again. **If this happens a lot to you let me know!**
### Gameplay Issues: 1. You can still receive techs in Techsanity from some ways that aren't traditional research: starting techs from your leader and tech trading, and this could lead to duplicates. These are planned to be removed in future updates. Let me know if things break because of them--they shouldn't, but I'm not 100% certain. 2. The settings aren't balanced at all, and it may make you do things like get 9 Great Scientists when all you have is the library or research Satellites before you have any economic techs. The Techsanity Era Gates setting should help the latter, and I'd highly recommend against large GPsanity numbers unless you have a lot of time to kill (though the added Great People in the pool will help). 3. There are a lot of debugging messages left in the mod. I removed some of them, but don't expect a clean feed. 4. When you're trying to select an "obsolete" wonder to build in the city screen, the building options will jump to the top of the building list due to the hacky way I've implemented that ability. I want to fix it eventually, but for now the easiest way to mitigate it is to use the wonder filter on the right side of the city list (the star), which will have it jump back to the start of the wonders, which hopefully won't make it jump. You can also use the "choose what to build next" dialog, or just select it without moving your mouse (use the scroll wheel).
### Technical Issues: 1. I had generation errors when creating solo/near-solo multiworlds with high Techsanity Era Gates values--I never tested with higher values with locations other than Techsanity enabled but keep that in mind if you're having trouble generating. 2. Whenever you close and reopen the game/a save file, you need to disconnect the client, and you should close and reopen the client to avoid missing checks. I plan to try and automate this in future updates. 3. There have been bug reports of items received/obtained while offline not properly appearing in-game and/or being sent to the multiworld when reconnecting. I think this is related to mismatching either mod or APworld versions, but I haven't fully found the root cause yet.
If you have any questions, bug reports, or things I forgot to mention, let me know in [the Civilization IV thread in the Archipelago Discord server](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1326231506682904576).
Github for the APWorld: https://github.com/VincentBorchardt/Archipelago/blob/main/worlds/civ_4/

entry.title: Slay the Spire II v1.1.0
entry.content:
Yes you will need a new APworld but your yaml only needs to change by one line from 1.0.1
## Multiplayer Stuff - Testing was done on beta branch so please use that. I did ZERO testing on the main branch for this. - Universal Buffs don't work, this is normal - they're automatically turned into 5 gold. - If you want to use the website to generate the yaml you sort of can: but you need to add a line for "player_count: 1", value can be 1-4. - You can either make one yaml for each player with "player_count: 1" aka one slot per player and each person joins their own slot. Host determines what ascensions and ascension downs count. Everything else should be player dependent - Alternatively: you can set "player_count: 2" or "player_count: 3" or "player_count: 4" in your yaml and everyone connects to the same slot. THEN in game (before you connect to a slot): you can hit Archipelago Settings -> Multiplayer settings and change your player number - Yes the above system can make you generate a big yaml with like 1000+ checks if you wanted to and you can play that in singleplayer. - There's too many multiplayer adjustments / design decisions that had to be done to get this working so just message in the discord channel if you're curious about something, thanks. Also if you need help setting up just ask. - Everyone needs the Archipelago mod installed, yes. Everyone must have the same mod list (if you've installed other mods like say character mods and discover a bug: your bugs will take less priority, try to only run RitsuLib and this Mod (and maybe BaseLib and modded characters but modded characters are also borked) - If you encounter a state divergence: just host again and try again. If this happens frequently: open the dev console with ` or shift+8 and type "ap report" and then send the zipfile (in discord) that it hopefully opens. state divergences are impossible to debug without this so without it: state divergences occur way way before it actually puts the message in game. - Manually Installing the Mod from GitHub Ensure that you have [RitsuLib](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3747602295) installed. The easiest way to obtain it is from Steam Workshop. Download the "Archipelago.zip" from Go to your Slay the Spire II directory (In Steam, click "Browse Local Files") If a folder called mods does not exist, create it Unzip the contents of Archipelago.zip into mods If you've done this step correctly, your directory structure should look like this: /<slay-the-spire-2-local-files>/mods/Archipelago/ and the contents of that folder should be a bunch of .dll files and a .pck file (there may be more files too, please don't touch anything in this folder)
## Random Bug Fixes - Have 2 saves in multiplayer: recent natural AP checkpoint (ie chests and bosses) and one checkpoint at each floor (probably a temporary adjustment while bugs and state divergences are common so you lose less progress). - Allow disconnecting and connecting to different multiworlds without restarting your game. - Allow golden compass to appear in start of act mode in act 2. - Many many many other bug fixes such as campfire softlock - Controller Support but only for beta branch - Massively overhauled architecture and restructuring of how Beta-Main compatibility works so things might break. - Fix !collect support - Fix progressive ancients, smiths and rests not being cleared in singleplayer leading to more than expected. - Option descriptions should be improved / better - Add accessibility and progression balancing in the yaml template and options creator (note website isn't updated until this stuff becomes a non experimental thing) - Ascension when launching should be more accurate - Shop Checks page button should be more noticeable (looks ugly though) - Shops send out hints automatically - Maybe fix the checks sending between different multiworlds - Remove lasting candy because its too complicated to support properly - Fix bug with visual display of 'Press Start location' being wrong in the Character Tracker UI - Golden Compass is now available in start of act mode in act 2.

entry.title: Kingdom Hearts Birth by Sleep v0.2.0
entry.content:
### DISCLAIMER Always check for updates in OpenKH for the AP Companion mod every time you play!
- Click Settings > Check Mods for Updates - If there are updates to the AP Mod, download them and rebuild your game using Mod Loader > Build and Run
The game is prone to crashing, PLEASE SAVE OFTEN
### How to play:
BEFORE MODDING, PLEASE INSTALL AND RUN KHBBS AT LEAST ONCE.
1. Install OpenKH and the Lua Backend. - Download the latest release of OpenKH here: https://github.com/OpenKH/OpenKh/releases/tag/latest - Extract the files to a directory of your choosing. - Open OpenKh.Tools.ModsManager.exe and run first time set up. - When prompted for game edition, choose PC, choose which platform you are playing on (Steam or EGS), navigate to your KH I.5 + II.5 installation folder in the path box, then click "Next" - When prompted, install Panacea, then click "Next" - When prompted, check KHBBS plus any other AP game you play (KH2) and click "Install and configure Lua backend", then click "Next". - Extracting game data for KHBBS is unnecessary, but you may want to extract data for KH2 if you plan on playing KH2 AP. - Click "Finish"
2. Open "OpenKh.Tools.ModsManager.exe" 3. Click the drop down menu at the top-right and choose "Birth by Sleep" 4. Click Mods>Install a New Mod 5. In "Add a new mod from GitHub" paste "gaithern/KH-BBS-AP-LUA" 6. Click Install 7. Navigate to Mod Loader and click "Build Only" 8. Place your khbbs.apworld file in your worlds folder (usually /lib/worlds/) 9. Run ArchipelagoLauncher.exe 10. Click "Generate Template Settings". This will open file explorer 11. Find "Kingdom Hearts Birth by Sleep.yaml" and copy it to /Players/ (create this folder if it does not exist) 12. Open the YAML file and change the line that says "name: Player{number}" to your desired player name. 13. Adjust the settings in the YAML to your liking 14. Run ArchipelagoGenerate.exe 15. Take the newly created AP_XXX.zip file in /output/ in upload it here: https://archipelago.gg/uploads 16. Open ArchipelagoLauncher.exe 17. Click "KHBBS Client" and connect to your server hosted on archipelago.gg 18. From the zip file mentioned above, retrieve the seed zip file (example: AP-95162914732603780136-P1-Player1_0.5.0.zip) 19. In OpenKH, click the green plus to add a mod, then click "Select and install Mod Archive or Lua Script" 20. Navigate to and select your seed zip. 21. With both the companion and the seed checked, click "Mod Loader", then "Build and Run" 22. Play!
----------
### How the randomizer works:
- All chests, stickers, bonus rewards, and pop up story rewards are randomized. - You must collect 3 Wayfinders to open The Keyblade Graveyard and complete your seed.

entry.title: Slay the Spire II v1.1.0r2
entry.content:
# Changelist
## Bonus Items and Wax Relics
* Added a new **Bonus Item** system! Bonus Items are useful non-progression rewards that are added to the item pool before filler items and can be customized in your YAML. ([[#265](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/265)](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/265)) * The first Bonus Item is the **Bonus Wax Relic**, which grants a temporary relic that melts after three combats. * Wax Relics can be configured as a specific relic or randomized from a customizable pool. * Bonus Items are entirely opt-in and none are added by default. * Eventually, there will be many more types of Bonus Items, such as **Max HP upgrades**, **Card Enchantments**, and more! * Added Wax Relic configuration to the online YAML Builder, including custom relic pools and relic selection. ([[#265](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/265)](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/265)) * Wax Relics are now handled directly by the Archipelago client, including Wax Relics received from ToyBox.
## Rewards, Shops, and Interface
* Reworked the Archipelago Reward UI to use Slay the Spire II's normal reward flow instead of a separate custom reward implementation. ([[#257](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/257)](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/257)) * This greatly simplifies interactions between Archipelago rewards and the base game. * Improved controller support across both the public and beta branches. * Added an L3 controller binding for opening the Archipelago Reward Menu. * Fixed controller navigation for Linked Ancient Relics. * Fixed Relic Coupon tradeability and improved the displayed coupon count. * Includes additional compatibility improvements for MacOS. * Fixed Rare Card Reward visuals and reward text sizing so long reward descriptions fit correctly. ([[#262](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/262)](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/262)) * Improved Shop Sanity navigation and hinting. ([[#275](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/275)](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/275)) * Shop Sanity checks are now automatically hinted. * Shop navigation buttons are visually distinguished and Archipelago shop checks now display an AP icon. * Fixed the character-select Ascension banner so it displays the correct current Ascension count after receiving Ascension Down items. ([[#269](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/269)](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/269))
## AP World and YAML Improvements
* **APWorld compatibility is no longer tied directly to the client release version.** ([[#266](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/266)](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/266)) * The client and APWorld now use a separate compatibility flag to determine whether they can safely connect. * Older APWorld versions can continue connecting when they are compatible instead of requiring the APWorld and client version numbers to advance together. * Version differences can still be used to recommend updating an older APWorld without unnecessarily blocking a connection. * Added proper `!collect` support by synchronizing collected locations with the client. ([[#277](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/277)](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/277); fixes [[#219](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/issues/219)](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/issues/219)) * **Neow Sanity now supports Anytime mode.** Neow Relics received after the beginning of a run can be collected through the Archipelago Reward Menu. ([[#278](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/278)](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/278)) * Fixed filler-item weighted selection. * Fixed and clarified several option descriptions and restored missing common options to generated YAML templates. ([[#278](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/278)](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/278)) * Corrected the Ascender's Bane option name. * Corrected the Ascension Down description. * Clarified that combat filler buffs are applied on the player's next turn rather than at the start of combat. * The YAML Builder received a substantial internal architecture refactor to share more relic and option data between the website, APWorld, and client. ([[#265](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/265)](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/265))
## Connection and Save Reliability
* Significantly improved connection and reconnection handling. ([[#268](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/268)](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/268)) * The client now automatically retries connections with backoff instead of immediately treating the first failed connection attempt as a recovery scenario. * The AP connection can now be directly connected and disconnected through the menu more reliably. * Offline checks are now isolated to the Multiworld they came from, preventing queued checks from accidentally being sent to a different Archipelago session after reconnecting. ([[#268](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/268)](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/268)) * Improved cleanup when intentionally leaving an Archipelago session, including slot-specific caches, callbacks, queued items, saves, and character state. ([[#268](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/268)](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/268))
## Bug Fixes & Reliability Updates
* Fixed **Press Start Location** offsets for non-starting characters, which could cause the wrong location to be sent or displayed in the tracker. ([[#267](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/267)](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/267)) * Fixed a Campfire softlock when Progressive Smith was available but the player had no upgradeable cards, including an edge case involving Meat Cleaver. ([[#267](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/267)](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/267)) * Fixed Progressive Item receipt counts being incorrectly restored from saves, which could cause items to be over-counted and invalid rewards to be granted. ([[#267](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/267)](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/267)) * **Golden Compass** can now appear in Act 2 Ancient Reward pools when using Chaos or True Chaos settings, as we've tested it to ensure it behaves properly. ([[#267](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/267)](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/267)) * **Lasting Candy** has been removed from Archipelago relic pools due to unreliable compatibility with Archipelago. ([[#267](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/267)](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/267))
## Internal Improvements
* Migrated the client project to **C# 14** and cleaned up the project configuration. ([[#258](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/258)](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/pull/258))
# Mod Information
## Pre-Requisites
- **Your host MUST use Archipelago Client v0.6.7+**. - This version of the mod is intended to be used for **v0.107.1** of Slay the Spire II - While we have experimental support for the public beta branch **v0.111.0**, we recommend **the "Default Public/Main Version"** of the game to most players. Since the beta branch is updated more frequently and is more volatile, it's less likely to be bug-free. Please use it at your own risk. However numerous players have used it just fine, @Terairk is the maintainer for this and he mostly develops here. - We will do our best to keep up with game updates as they release, so please be patient when encountering issues.
## Installing the Mod from Steam Workshop (Recommended)
1. Ensure that you have [RitsuLib](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3747602295) installed. The easiest way to obtain it is from Steam Workshop. 2. Subscribe to the [Slay the Spire II Archipelago Client](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3748826296) on Steam Workshop. 3. Make sure that any other unnecessary mods are turned off, unless you're trying to use a specific modded character for your Archipelago session. 4. Start the game
## Manually Installing the Mod from GitHub
1. Ensure that you have [RitsuLib](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3747602295) installed. The easiest way to obtain it is from Steam Workshop. 2. Download the "sts2-client.zip" from the [Releases](https://github.com/dlueben1/Slay-the-Spire-2-Archipelago/releases/latest) section of the Repo 3. Go to your Slay the Spire II directory (In Steam, click "Browse Local Files") 4. If a folder called `mods` does not exist, create it 5. Unzip the **contents** of `sts2-client.zip` into `mods`
- If you've done this step correctly, your directory structure should look like this: `/<slay-the-spire-2-local-files>/mods/Archipelago/` and the contents of that folder should be a bunch of `.dll` files and a `.pck` file (there may be more files too, please don't touch anything in this folder)
6. Start the game
### Additional Steps for **Hosts**
7. Download `spire2.apworld` 8. Open your Archipelago Launcher 9. Click "Install APWorld" 10. Select `spire2.apworld` in the file dialog that pops up 11. **Restart the Archipelago Launcher** 12. Now you should be able to properly host/generate an Archipelago Session with StS 2
- If you want to use `archipelago.gg` to host the game, generate it locally first following the steps above, then upload the `.zip` file from the `output` folder in your Archipelago installation
> [!IMPORTANT] > You need to use Archipelago Version 0.6.7+ and CANNOT use earlier versions of Archipelago with this mod!
## Known Issues/Limitations
- Switching Slay the Spire II branches during an active run may make that run's checkpoint incompatible with the other branch.
## Common Q&A
### Will this mess with my unmodded Save File?
No.
### I installed the AP World but it's not working
Is your Archipelago Launcher v0.6.7 or later? If not it **won't work**.
